name: io.github.amineutron/mcp-guard
title: mcp-guard
description: Enterprise MCP guard: roles, allowlist policy, human confirmation and JSONL audit log, with example tools.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GUARD_ROLE
environmentVariables.description: Caller role: lecteur (read-only), operateur, admin. Defaults to lecteur.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GUARD_CONFIRM
environmentVariables.description: elicit: the server asks the human; client: the client confirms itself from destructiveHint.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_GUARD_AUDIT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory of the JSONL audit log.
